TRPA1 activation causes neurogenic vasodilation via the release of calcitonin gene‐related peptide (CGRP) and nitric oxide (NO), with a contribution of reactive oxygen species and nitric oxide.

the mechanisms of neurogenic vasodilation are complex and include both CGRP and NO, but that TRPA1 activation also leads to the production of reactive oxygen species and reactive nitrogen species that contribute to the vasodilatory response.
The main takeaway from our work is that
TRPA1‐dependent neurogenic vasodilation is mediated by both CGRP and NO, but not by ROS or NOS.
